articles.title: Catch the Perseid Meteor Shower: Nature's Fireworks Show!
articles.summary: The Perseid meteor shower peaks August 12-13! You could see up to 100 shooting stars an hour. Find a dark spot, look up, and make a wish!

articles.title: Singing Could Help Stop Embarrassing Burps, New Study Says
articles.summary: A rare burping disorder might be helped by singing! A new study found that singing therapy reduced burping more than breathing exercises. But some experts aren't sure.

articles.title: Swiatek Wins First Title of the Season at Canadian Open
articles.summary: Iga Swiatek beat Elena Rybakina 6-2 6-3 in Toronto to win her first title of the season. It was her 26th career title and a big comeback after a tough year.
